discovery: lifecycle_study.discovery_days only, 533 days through 2023-03-14; no validation outcomes or FREEZE marker

events_schema.features: numeric feature_ prefixed explicit past-only variables. Include feature_t, feature_clock, feature_rank, feature_tenure, price/rank/volume/tape allowlists and trailing5/15/30 memory. Missing stays null/NaN. event types encoded as feature_event_<type> binary. No execution prices/outcomes enter features.
events_schema.semantics: Completed bar t-1 state -> first observed open at et>=t. Events only t>original fill_et. Final session_end row always included, terminal liquidation invalid beyond session_end = UNKNOWN. Retention labels need later actual sell_et>current sell_et, not multiple observations pointing to same delayed open.

training_contract.objective: Incremental dollar value of owned-share stopping from the decision onward. Selling now is zero incremental dollars. Entry fee sunk; common exit fee scales retained-minus-realized value.
training_contract.fitted_value_iteration: DECLARED LIMITED BENCHMARK (--algorithm value_iteration), explicitly different from policy_return: y=(next_sell_px-sell_px)/original_fill_px + max(0,q_pred_at_next_event) over the fixed strict-next_sequence status==0 support; q per original gross notional on fixed share basis. Terminal nextq=0. It uses the strict next-liquidation pointer (skips same-open reprints) and freezes support before the iterations, so it must not be read as the adaptive policy. Three cumulative feature views, 3 chronological folds and 8 iterations/80 rounds unchanged; TRAIN only. Entry fee sunk, common exit fee scales realized dollars. Dataset bins reused, labels change. No clipping/tuning.
training_contract.controlled_refinement: policy_return: RETAIN/WAIT target is the next emitted causal decision event, then the actual previous learned policy's chronological stop (owned_claim_policy_targets.py), with target (chosen-policy liquidation sell_px - current sell_px)/original_fill on fixed original shares. The walk is the emitted event order (sequence+1), NEVER the strict next_sequence liquidation pointer, and it does NOT force an exit to a strictly later print: a release at an event that reprints the same opening within session legitimately yields zero incremental variable-policy dollars. Availability depends on the chosen actual policy liquidation only: current print and chosen exit must both be finite/positive/in-session, otherwise the row is UNKNOWN and excluded (never zeroed); an unused unknown suffix cannot censor it. Iteration0 all-zero q is a full-session hold initialization ruler only and is never the resulting policy. Fit support and inverse claim-event/day weights are recomputed every iteration; the LightGBM Dataset bins are reused only when the fit mask is identical. Same features/params/8 updates/3 folds/cumulative views; no new selection or threshold grid. Fixed-horizon V15/V30/V60/V120 labels are untouched and stay UNKNOWN when a feasible observed liquidation is missing. TRAIN-only prices/labels; TEST predictions use features only, with the calendar session terminal (t>=session_end) the only zero pin. Baseline source/results preserved at commit76db4a1. No protected outcomes.
training_contract.outputs: scores/<day>.parquet with keys + pred_state,pred_history,pred_tape for test days only; metadata.json with explicit train/test sets, source pins, iteration configs and coverage; model diagnostic json. No protected-half access. No expensive runtime until parent gives ready message; parent owns serial compute.

portfolio_contract.actions: Stop/retain, one repair reentry, and one cash rotation/reinforcement diagnostic using fresh same-roster observations with positive marginal value beyond fresh fee hurdle. N3/N5 candidate/ownership universes independent. New-buy shares fixed at completed mark: 90% of reserved settled budget/(mark*(1+side)); price gaps exceeding cash reservation are UNKNOWN, never resized or financed. Original equal-dollar admission remains a declared starting ruler. Sale receipts usable only exec_et+1, blocked admission funds only clock+5.
portfolio_contract.prediction_units: Owned dollars q_actual*original_fill*(1-side)*pred_abs; fresh-dollar comparison pred_abs*original_fill/causal_mark versus2*side/(1-side).

attribution_contract.independent_inputs: existing harvestability days members/fills/daily, plus source discovery-only panel and roster as needed. Output standalone producer under factory/scripts/owned_claim_attribution.py and compact json under factory/artifacts/owned_claim_attribution.json. Parent runs it after implementation.
attribution_contract.questions: N3 vs N5 each clock, 13:00 ruler. Pair hold,fade,bank5_f75_fade on common known days. Split complete-window MFE classes(<10,10..30,30..100,>=100) from observed panel peak_gain<=780; NEVER roster mfe_day(afterhours) or personality routes. Entry friction, exit friction, gross move, realized lost option (fade vs hold and bank vs fade), residual shares/dollars at 09:45/10:30/11:30, rank and peer contributions, top5/top10 day/name contribution and worst5/worst10 losses. Contributions sum exactly to net portfolio EV. Separate low-excursion tax from terminal-return loss anatomy. Report timing and full-exit vs partials, release-before+5/+30 signals. Do not call unseen MFE an executable payoff; opportunity max sell_px may be measured as retrospective upper bound, explicitly unattainable.

audit_contract: Review contract and new model/event code for inherited-cost accounting, next-open clocks, feature leakage, chronology, UNKNOWN and cash conservation. No edits. Read known lifecycle inputs first. Parent will message when new files exist. No build/lint/tests/formatters mid-flight. Never touch other workstreams or pre-existing dirt.
